# KTM family: aftermarket parts research catalog

Research candidates gathered from public web sources (manufacturer pages, dealers, retailers, magazine tests, testers, forums). Each product keeps its source and a confidence: high = the manufacturer lists the part number and fitment; medium = a dealer or major retailer does; unverified = inferred or title-only. Nothing here is verified evidence, nothing is shown to riders yet, and no fitment, price or performance claim should be repeated without checking the source. Performance claims are the maker's or tester's, with their conditions.

Files: bars_clamps.json, bars_clamps2.json, brakes_controls.json, cg-ktm-family.json, chains_wheels.json, chassis.json, chassis2.json, cooling_valvetrain.json, dealer-ktmtwins.json, dealer-lings.json, drivetrain.json, engine.json, engine2.json, engine_services.json, house_brands.json, house_brands2.json, ktm-chassis-controls-wheels.json, ktm-engine-clutch-cooling.json, ktm-exhaust-intake-fuel.json, ktm-oem-accessories.json, ktm-rider-feedback.json, ms-ktm-family.json, p2-confirmations.json, p2-controls-wheels-protection.json, p2-engine-clutch-oem.json, p2-exhaust-2stroke-85.json, p2-rider-feedback.json, p4-bearings-mounts.json, p4-gapfill.json, p4-husqvarna-gasgas-accessories.json, p4-powerparts-ktm.json, suspension.json, tuning.json, valvetrain2.json. Built by scripts/aftermarket/build_catalog.py.

Counts: 12250 products, 33936 part numbers, 83 rider/tester findings, 17 project-bike builds, 224 of 224 in-scope bike-years with at least one mapped product.
